about: Every documented feature of the Mac app and its clip. A feature's clip is docs/features/<id>.webp, recorded by mac/scripts/feature-clips.sh on `screen`, zoomed on the view marked `.featureSpot("<spot>")`, playing its demo from FeatureClipScripts.swift, with `title`, `caption` (what it does) and `use` (when to use it) over it. `sources` are the files whose changes mean the clip must be recorded again. See CLAUDE.md.

features.title: Every pair, one click away
features.caption: Pick a pair in the menu and your pointer changes right away.
features.use: Use it when you want a pointer you can spot at a glance on any screen.

features.title: Your pair at a glance
features.caption: See the pair on screen, copy its colors, and get a warning when they're hard to see.
features.use: Use it to check a pair's colors, copy them, or catch one that's hard to see.

features.title: Any pointer size
features.caption: Drag to resize the pointer, or give each display its own size.
features.use: Use it on big or sharp displays, or whenever the pointer is hard to follow.

features.title: Preview before you pick
features.caption: See the pointer on light pages, dark apps, photos and spreadsheets.
features.use: Use it to choose a pair that stays easy to see wherever you work.

features.title: A pair for each display
features.caption: Colors switch as the pointer crosses to another display.
features.use: Use it with more than one display, so each screen gets the pair that suits it.

features.title: Highlight from the menu
features.caption: Click the pulse or the laser picture to turn it on or off.
features.use: Use it to switch highlights on right before a demo or a call.

features.title: Make your own pairs
features.caption: Add, edit, hide, import and export pairs in Preferences › Pairs.
features.use: Use it to match your brand, your setup, or your own favorite colors.

features.title: Follows light and dark
features.caption: One pair for light appearance, another for dark, switched for you.
features.use: Use it if your Mac switches between light and dark during the day.

features.title: A pair for each app
features.caption: Each app gets its own pair while the pointer is over it, or while it's in front.
features.use: Use it when some apps are dark and others light, like Terminal next to Safari.

features.title: Show every click
features.caption: A pulse on each click, a laser trail and a ring, for demos and recordings.
features.use: Use it when you present, teach, or record your screen.

features.title: Ring or ripple pulses
features.caption: Pick the pulse style, size and length, and show long presses.
features.use: Use it when you record or share your screen, so people see every click.

features.title: A laser that draws
features.caption: Drag to draw a fading trail, draw only while holding keys you choose, and choose its outline and when the dot shows.
features.use: Use it to point things out while you present or record, like a laser pointer.

features.title: Highlight colors per pair
features.caption: Set a pulse and a laser color for any pair.
features.use: Use it when a pair's own colors don't stand out enough as a pulse or laser.

features.title: Shortcuts from any app
features.caption: Switch pairs and resize the pointer without opening the menu.
features.use: Use it to change the pointer mid-task, without reaching for the menu.

features.title: Make the menu yours
features.caption: Theme, glass, tint and text size for the menu and Preferences.
features.use: Use it to make the menu and Preferences match your Mac, or easier to read.

features.title: Take your settings anywhere
features.caption: Export every setting to one file, and import it on this Mac or another.
features.use: Use it when you set up a new Mac, or before you try new settings.

features.title: Updates like any Mac app
features.caption: See what's new, then skip it, install on quit, or install and relaunch.
features.use: Use it to choose when an update installs, so it never interrupts you.

features.title: Updates in one click
features.caption: Check on a schedule, read what's new, and install without a security prompt.
features.use: Use it to stay current without checking the website.
